question: Does a contradiction-gated context-specific factor replacement discover and remove obsolete causal structures while protecting unaffected predictions, with better unfamiliar-world transfer than fully trained conventional controls?
hypothesis: A frozen 0.12-MSE-improvement gate that can replace one old causal motif will preserve old-context held error within 1%, avoid ≥90% of false interventions in unchanged worlds, recover ≥70% of exact old-to-new factor replacements in changed worlds, and exceed the best fully trained conventional method by ≥10% cold MSE.

custody.source_kind: Entirely synthetic, no native checkpoint, real-world data, paid API, GPU, first-use science or runtime controller.

protocol.causal_generator: 12 externally intervened binary variables with 364 finite known unary/pair/triple parity and AND motifs; 10 latent causal bits with two correlation-shifting nuisance bits; 3 stable hidden factors plus an old-only and new-only factor, signed weights of magnitude .85–1.15; independent Gaussian consequence noise sigma=.3; the 4th world_id (3) has no actual mechanism change, only shifted nuisance cues. Independent generators re-create exact double-precision outcomes.
protocol.latent_support_source: Hidden factor indices and coefficients are evaluator-only; old/new randomized interventions and observed training consequences are given to learners. A predefined finite grammar is available to models and is NOT claimed to be autonomously discovered.
protocol.candidate: Old-context OMP4 recovers four feature supports; freeze entire old predictor. For new context use first 72 new witness outcomes to estimate four-factor error, rank top24 alternatives by residual correlation, exhaustively evaluate 4×24 single-drop-and-add support replacements. Select based ONLY on last 24 new training outcomes; trigger if 24-label validation MSE improvement ≥0.12. When triggered, refit new-context selected four feature weights on all 96 new witness outcomes; otherwise use old selected four support identities refit from 96 new labels. Old context still uses immutable old coefficients. Changed context support may be replaced; cold observations use new-context model with no additional learning.
arms: unconditional_replace (same capacity but no contradiction gate, selects on all 96 new)
omp_delta2 (conventional 2-factor residual correction and frozen old predictor)
stagewise_omp4 (standard independent 4-feature OMP trained on 96 new, frozen old predictor)
shuffled_gate (new witness outcomes shuffled, same replacement+gate and data budget)
negative_controls: world_id=3 no-change causal law with nuisance cue shift; fake gate must avoid intervention
strong_controls: stagewise new-context OMP4 exactly matches active new-context capacity and 192 total observed outcomes
best trained cumulative ElasticNet, OMP7 and structured-memory OMP7
metrics: Mean disjoint old,new,cold held squared consequence error
Exact old-only deleted and new-only support added (changed-world rate)
No-change worlds with false gate (world id3)
old-context error after new learning vs original immutable checkpoint and best conventional control
per-seed cold MSE vs best independently fully trained control
single-core summed Python fit+predict wall time excluding shared old OMP4 prefit, source data generation, interpreter startup, audit and GitHub API
protocol.runtime: Local Linux CPU Python 3.13.5, NumPy 2.3.5, sklearn 1.8.0; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, no paid API/GPU.
protocol.allowed_execution: One 36-world fixed primary, exactly one unchanged-source canonical semantic replay and independent all-world 11-arm audit. No postscore tuning; transient execution does not imply native scientific acceptance.

frozen_gates.cold_vs_strongest_10pct: Candidate aggregate held-cold MSE <=0.90 × minimum mean cold MSE over fully fitted conventional omp_delta2,stagewise_omp4,omp_structural_memory,full_omp7,elasticnet,ridge,forest.
frozen_gates.cold_vs_stagewise_omp4_5pct: Candidate held-cold MSE <=0.95 × conventional stagewise_omp4 held cold MSE.
frozen_gates.old_prediction_protected_1pct: Candidate old-context MSE <=1.01 × immutable stage-one old-context MSE.
frozen_gates.old_vs_best_control_5pct: Candidate old-context MSE <=1.05 × best old-context MSE among fully fitted conventional controls.
frozen_gates.replaced_truth_support_70pct: In 27 actually changed worlds exact candidate deletion equals true old-only factor AND added support equals new-only factor, with gate triggered, at least 70% successes.
frozen_gates.nochange_false_gate_at_most_10pct: In 9 unchanged latent worlds, candidate must decline replacement at least 90% of the time.
frozen_gates.sham_negative_new_20pct: Candidate held new-context MSE <=0.80 × shuffled-label gate control new-context MSE.
frozen_gates.seed_stability_2of3: Strictly better candidate mean cold MSE than strongest independently trained conventional arm within at least two of three primary seeds.
frozen_gates.cost_max_3x_stagewise: Candidate accumulated locally measured fit+predict wall <= 3× stagewise_omp4 accumulated fit+predict wall (old OMP4 prefit shared, excluded for both).

classification.development_go: ALL NINE gates PASS AND independently authored full 36-world 11-arm refit audit PASS. Still not SCIENTIFIC_PASS/native training.
classification.development_no_go: One or more frozen gates fail with valid source, leakage controls and full independent audit. Preserve negative and do not tune primary seeds.
classification.invalid: Missing source before freeze, changed original source or controls, primary execution before this commit, hidden truth/held labels passed into learner, mismatched budgets, audit/refit failure or score/threshold error. Invalid infrastructure is not a valid science negative.
classification.mixed: Report all gates, controls, uncertainty/limited sample size and no selective promotion.

preprimary_smoke.meaning: Implementation qualification only; one excluded seed cannot satisfy multi-seed gate and not primary evidence.

after_primary_prohibited: No source, gate, seed, split or hyperparameter changes on consumed primary worlds
No more than one unchanged-source semantic replay
No native Yggdrasil checkpoint, research loop, scheduler, runner, queue, main, protected science first-use, merge or deployment
